title: The Six Hug Commandments: Design and Evaluation of a Human-Sized Hugging Robot with Visual and Haptic Perception
reasoning: The paper uses the term 'Commandments' metaphorically to refer to its six proposed design principles ('tenets') for a hugging robot.
